handyMigration.quitHandy:
Handy is still running, so Legato can't bring over your settings and history yet.

Quit Handy from its tray icon, then choose Retry. If you choose Cancel, Legato starts without them and won't ask again. They stay in Handy's folder.
handyMigration.filesInUse:
Something still has files open in Handy's folder, so Legato can't bring over your settings and history yet.

Close any program that might be using them, then choose Retry. If you choose Cancel, Legato starts without them and won't ask again. They stay in Handy's folder.
handyMigration.uninstallHandy:
Your settings, history and recordings are now in Legato.

Uninstall Handy so the two apps don't both run and fight over the same shortcut. Open Windows Settings to uninstall it?

idle.title: When idle
idle.description: A small island stays at the top with Dictate, Notes and the Scratchpad on hover. Hide shows it only while there's something to show.

position.title: Position
position.description: Where the Legato bar appears while you dictate.

pasteMethod.description: How the text gets into the app. Ctrl+V works in most apps.

clipboardHandling.description: Put back what you had copied, or leave the transcript there to paste again.

pressEnterByVoice.description: Ending a dictation with “press enter” pastes it without those words, then presses Enter.

stackedMessages.label: A message per paragraph in chat apps
stackedMessages.description: In apps Style calls personal or work messages, each paragraph is sent on its own.

autoSubmit.title: Auto-submit after paste
autoSubmit.description: Presses a key after pasting, to send a message or a prompt.

translateToEnglish.label: Translate to English
translateToEnglish.description: Writes English whatever language you speak, without an AI provider.

modelUnload.title: Unload model after
modelUnload.description: Frees your graphics card when you haven't dictated for that long. The model waits on the processor meanwhile, so your next dictation starts at once. A model that runs on the processor is unloaded instead.

customWords.title: Your words
customWords.description: Names and terms Legato should spell your way. Correcting near misses works for words made of A–Z and numbers.

voiceActivityDetection.title: Voice activity detection
voiceActivityDetection.description: Cuts silence before transcribing, so pauses don't turn into made-up words.

longFormChunking.title: Split long recordings
longFormChunking.description: Splits long recordings at pauses, so a long dictation doesn't stall.

vadBackend.title: Voice detection engine
vadBackend.description: Silero is more accurate. Earshot is lighter on older CPUs and still experimental.

fillerWordRemoval.title: Remove filler words

liveCaption.help: While the bubble has your dictation, a see-through box at the top or bottom of the screen shows the words as you say them. Needs a speech model that writes as you speak.

confirmPaste.title: Confirm after pasting
confirmPaste.help: The bar says how many words went where, with Undo.

showChanges.help: For two seconds after a transform, the bar shows the text before and after, with Undo; point at it to keep it open. Turn this off and the bar shows nothing. Home keeps every Before and After either way.

failedPastes.description: A dictation that can't be pasted is always saved there. With this on, the window opens on it so you can copy it or send it again.

detect.title: Detect calls and offer notes
detect.help: Windows tells Legato when an app starts using the microphone, and Legato offers notes in the Legato bar without listening to the audio.

hideCard.help: Others in the call won't see the card when you share your screen.

notesFolder.title: Keep notes in a folder

mcp.title: Let AI apps read Legato

inyon.title: Inyon
inyon.help: Pair with your Inyon hub to see agents that are waiting for you on the bar or the island, and answer them there.
inyon.where: In Inyon, open Settings › Paired devices: paste its pairing link here, or type the hub's address and the code from Pair a companion app (or inyon hub companion-code on the hub's computer). A code works once, for 5 minutes.

alerts.title: Agents on the bar

inyon.removedThere: Inyon removed Legato. Pair again with a new code.

toggle.title: Tell speakers apart
toggle.help: After a meeting, and every so often during it, each line gets the voice that said it: Speaker 1, Speaker 2, or the name you give them. Up to four voices per meeting.

model.title: Speaker model
model.help: Needed to tell voices apart. {{size}} MB, downloaded with your first meeting and run on this PC.
model.licence: NVIDIA Streaming Sortformer, under the NVIDIA Open Model License.

remember.title: Remember voices
remember.help: When you name a speaker, Legato keeps an 8-second clip of their voice and puts the name on them in later meetings. The clips stay on this PC and are never synced or sent anywhere.

voices.title: Saved voices
voices.help: Recognised names show with a dot; rename one if it's wrong, or forget the voice here.
voices.none: None yet. Name a speaker in a note to save their voice.

notes.title: Notes
notes.help: Voice memos and meeting notes, with call offers and meeting cards. Off hides the Notes page, its shortcut and its buttons.

scratchpad.title: Scratchpad
scratchpad.help: Notes you dictate or type into a small window. Off hides its page, shortcut and buttons; a paste that fails still lands there, so nothing is lost.

transforms.title: Transforms and Ask
transforms.help: Rewrite a selection or your last dictation with your own AI, or ask it something. Needs an AI provider in Settings › AI.

insights.title: Insights
insights.help: How much you dictate, and how often Legato gets a word wrong.

none.help: Pastes what the model heard, with Dictionary fixes and snippets only.

light.help: Removes fillers, repeats and false starts; writes numbers as digits. No AI.

medium.label: Medium
medium.help: Light, then your AI smooths the grammar without changing what you said.

punctuation.help: Say “comma”, “period”, “question mark” or “new line” to type them, and “github dot com” for github.com.

corrections.title: Self-corrections
corrections.help: “at 3, actually 4” keeps 4; “at 12, no, I want it at 4” keeps the second try; “scratch that” drops what came before it.

lists.title: Lists
lists.help: “first … second … third” becomes a list where the kind of app lays one out.

paragraphs.title: Paragraphs
paragraphs.help: A long dictation breaks into paragraphs where the thought changes, as at “Also” or “Let me know”; never in code.

reason.badAddress: That doesn't look like a hub address. Try https://hub.example.com, or host:port.
reason.badCode: That code didn't work. Codes work once, for 5 minutes; make a new one in Inyon.
reason.rateLimit: Too many tries. Wait a minute and try again.
reason.unreachable: Couldn't reach the hub. Check the address and that this PC can reach it.
reason.notAHub: Something answered at that address, but it isn't an Inyon hub that pairs companion apps (0.20 or later).
reason.contract: This hub speaks a different version of the companion contract. Update Inyon or Legato.
reason.vault: Windows Credential Manager wouldn't keep the hub's token.
reason.signedOut: The hub doesn't know Legato any more. Pair again in Settings › Connections.
reason.paneGone: That session isn't there any more.
reason.promptOpen: The agent is asking something; answer it first.
reason.busy: The agent can't take text right now.
reason.notLanded: Sent, but the hub couldn't confirm it arrived.
reason.noAgent: No agent runs in that session.
reason.scope: Legato isn't allowed to do that.
reason.notAnOption: Didn't catch which option. Say its number or its words.
reason.insecure: Legato pairs over https, or over plain http only on this PC or a NetBird or Tailscale address, so nobody on the network can read the hub's token. Use the hub's https address.
reason.untrusted: Windows doesn't trust this hub's certificate. In Inyon, open Settings › Paired devices › Copy pairing link, and paste the link here: it names the hub's own certificate.
reason.badLink: That pairing link isn't complete. Copy it again in Inyon's Paired devices.
